turns.user: What 7-day compressive strength would you expect for a plain OPC paste with w/c 0.45, tested on 40 mm prisms (EN 196)?
turns.text:
I’ll run the compressive-strength model using the specified paste, w/c 0.45, age 7 days, and the 40 mm prism specimen group. I’ll use moist curing as the default because curing was not specified.
The first run failed because the mix name contained “w/c,” which the report writer interpreted as a folder separator. I’ve corrected the name and am retrying once with the same technical inputs.
Expected 7-day compressive strength: **27.8 [16.9, 58.7] MPa** (median [80% prediction interval]).

Assumptions: 100% Portland cement paste, w/c = 0.45, moist curing, and `comp_prism40` for the EN 196 prism geometry. The input is within the model’s training range. This literature-derived correlation requires experimental verification.

Outputs: `predictions_Plain_OPC_paste_7d.csv` and `predictions_Plain_OPC_paste_7d.png`.
